description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Individual reported first-tier subaward records: which subcontractor worked under which prime, for how much. Filter by prime contractor name. Amounts are prime-reported subaward amounts, often incomplete or duplicated; they are not cash paid and not obligations. Not a partnership suggestion. Present as information only; do not frame results as a bid/no-bid recommendation, eligibility determination, or partnership recommendation. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
